_readme: Recordings that ship with the game, so a class needs no setup.
To add them: drop clips in this folder named by romaji (a.mp3, ka.mp3,
shi.mp3, kya.mp3 ...), list those romaji in 'mora' below, set 'ext' to
the file extension, and put the recordist's name in 'credit'. Push, and
everyone at the URL hears them. Leave 'mora' empty and the game uses the
device's own Japanese voice, as it always has.
A pack a player loads themselves still takes precedence over this one.
